I have wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but the kitchen is too small and we do not cook a lot of food, so I could not bring in a dishwasher because of my husband's opposition. Also, sadly, I cannot drill holes in the house. I cannot drill holes for water inlet and outlet, make holes, or do whatever I want with the kitchen cabinets. I think I could hardly even dream of installing a large dishwasher. Then, I found this dishwasher with a minimal size and got it. The criteria for the dishwasher I want are 1. It should be a minimal size that does not take up much space in the kitchen and should not be difficult to drill holes or install - It is really easy to install! Just place it in a horizontal place and put the drain hose in it and place it where it will drain. And it seems easier to just supply water myself. I think I fill the large water tank four or five times. When the water is filled properly, it will beep and then you should stop the water supply immediately. 2. It is not difficult to use - After filling the water, add detergent and press the mode you want by hand to operate. It couldn't be simpler. 3. Even the mini size is big enough to fit the largest plate I use - We are a family of 3 and we do not eat a lot of food or eat often. So when cups or small dishes come out, it is good to wash them and put them away right away. The largest plate is a white flat IKEA plate, and it fits if you tilt it to the side. I think it might be a little difficult to use for people who use a lot of large plates. It is a good size to put in rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, spoons, and side plates. It is a dishwasher that fits my lifestyle. If it is too big, it will not be done this quickly, and if you have to run a lot at once, it will be burdensome and the dishes will pile up. *** As I continued to use it, I realized that there are more minor disadvantages than I thought. 1. The process of adding water that requires a lot of concentration! - Many reviews said that an error occurred, but I didn't know that I would be the one who would experience that error. The E4 error occurred! This is really important. They say that you should plug in the dishwasher cord and turn on the power button! Then, add water to avoid this error. I knew this in advance from the product review, so I thought I could use it with confidence. After my husband installed it, he just poured water without thinking and didn't turn on the power button. Then, when he turned on the power button, the E4 error occurred. I looked for a blog review, and it said to drain all the water, clean it thoroughly, and then use it again. So I drained all the water, dried it, and dried it thoroughly. I barely managed to use it after getting an error and drying it several times. Please read my review and keep in mind! You should always turn on the power before adding water. And if you hear a beep while adding water, immediately stop the water supply. This is really a sustress. 2. Drying and blowing function. This is the most disappointing feature, though. When the dishwasher is done washing, it seems to dry the dishes like a fine (?) wind. If you don't open the door, it will continue to blow and dry the dishes. The blowing function is so weak that I've never seen the dishes completely dry by the next day. So it dries better if you just leave the door open. The problem is that when you leave the door open, it gets in the way of going in and out because of the door. So I bought a safety device from Daiso to prevent the door from opening and closing, and I can keep it slightly open. The door is either completely closed or completely open, which is a polar opposite. There are some disappointing points, but I'm satisfied with the price. I always have to consider the price of home appliances, so I don't want to be a greedy person anymore. If you think drying is important, you should look for other products with added functions. My husband, who said he wouldn't use it because it was a bit annoying to fill the water, is more diligent than anyone else in filling the water and running the dishwasher. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

It should be a minimal size that does not take up much space in the kitchen and should not be difficult to drill holes or install - It is really easy to install! Just place it in a horizontal place and put the drain hose in it and place it where it will drain. And it seems easier to just supply water myself. I think I fill the large water tank four or five times. When the water is filled properly, it will beep and then you should stop the water supply immediately. 2. It is not difficult to use - After filling the water, add detergent and press the mode you want by hand to operate. It couldn't be simpler. 3. Even the mini size is big enough to fit the largest plate I use - We are a family of 3 and we do not eat a lot of food or eat often. So when cups or small dishes come out, it is good to wash them and put them away right away. The largest plate is a white flat IKEA plate, and it fits if you tilt it to the side. I think it might be a little difficult to use for people who use a lot of large plates. It is a good size to put in rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, spoons, and side plates. It is a dishwasher that fits my lifestyle. If it is too big, it will not be done this quickly, and if you have to run a lot at once, it will be burdensome and the dishes will pile up. *** As I continued to use it, I realized that there are more minor disadvantages than I thought. 1. The process of adding water that requires a lot of concentration! - Many reviews said that an error occurred, but I didn't know that I would be the one who would experience that error. The E4 error occurred! This is really important. They say that you should plug in the dishwasher cord and turn on the power button! Then, add water to avoid this error. I knew this in advance from the product review, so I thought I could use it with confidence. After my husband installed it, he just poured water without thinking and didn't turn on the power button. Then, when he turned on the power button, the E4 error occurred. I looked for a blog review, and it said to drain all the water, clean it thoroughly, and then use it again. So I drained all the water, dried it, and dried it thoroughly. I barely managed to use it after getting an error and drying it several times. Please read my review and keep in mind! You should always turn on the power before adding water. And if you hear a beep while adding water, immediately stop the water supply. This is really a sustress. 2. Drying and blowing function. This is the most disappointing feature, though. When the dishwasher is done washing, it seems to dry the dishes like a fine (?) wind. If you don't open the door, it will continue to blow and dry the dishes. The blowing function is so weak that I've never seen the dishes completely dry by the next day. So it dries better if you just leave the door open. The problem is that when you leave the door open, it gets in the way of going in and out because of the door. So I bought a safety device from Daiso to prevent the door from opening and closing, and I can keep it slightly open. The door is either completely closed or completely open, which is a polar opposite. There are some disappointing points, but I'm satisfied with the price. I always have to consider the price of home appliances, so I don't want to be a greedy person anymore. If you think drying is important, you should look for other products with added functions. My husband, who said he wouldn't use it because it was a bit annoying to fill the water, is more diligent than anyone else in filling the water and running the dishwasher. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

I think it might be a little difficult to use for people who use a lot of large plates. It is a good size to put in rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, spoons, and side plates. It is a dishwasher that fits my lifestyle. If it is too big, it will not be done this quickly, and if you have to run a lot at once, it will be burdensome and the dishes will pile up. *** As I continued to use it, I realized that there are more minor disadvantages than I thought. 1. The process of adding water that requires a lot of concentration! - Many reviews said that an error occurred, but I didn't know that I would be the one who would experience that error. The E4 error occurred! This is really important. They say that you should plug in the dishwasher cord and turn on the power button! Then, add water to avoid this error. I knew this in advance from the product review, so I thought I could use it with confidence. After my husband installed it, he just poured water without thinking and didn't turn on the power button. Then, when he turned on the power button, the E4 error occurred. I looked for a blog review, and it said to drain all the water, clean it thoroughly, and then use it again. So I drained all the water, dried it, and dried it thoroughly. I barely managed to use it after getting an error and drying it several times. Please read my review and keep in mind! You should always turn on the power before adding water. And if you hear a beep while adding water, immediately stop the water supply. This is really a sustress. 2. Drying and blowing function. This is the most disappointing feature, though. When the dishwasher is done washing, it seems to dry the dishes like a fine (?) wind. If you don't open the door, it will continue to blow and dry the dishes. The blowing function is so weak that I've never seen the dishes completely dry by the next day. So it dries better if you just leave the door open. The problem is that when you leave the door open, it gets in the way of going in and out because of the door. So I bought a safety device from Daiso to prevent the door from opening and closing, and I can keep it slightly open. The door is either completely closed or completely open, which is a polar opposite. There are some disappointing points, but I'm satisfied with the price. I have wanted to buy a dishwasher for a long time, but the kitchen is too small and we do not cook a lot of food, so I could not bring in a dishwasher because of my husband's opposition. Also, sadly, I cannot drill holes in the house. I cannot drill holes for water inlet and outlet, make holes, or do whatever I want with the kitchen cabinets. I think I could hardly even dream of installing a large dishwasher. Then, I found this dishwasher with a minimal size and got it. The criteria for the dishwasher I want are 1. It should be a minimal size that does not take up much space in the kitchen and should not be difficult to drill holes or install - It is really easy to install! Just place it in a horizontal place and put the drain hose in it and place it where it will drain. And it seems easier to just supply water myself. I think I fill the large water tank four or five times. When the water is filled properly, it will beep and then you should stop the water supply immediately. 2. It is not difficult to use - After filling the water, add detergent and press the mode you want by hand to operate. It couldn't be simpler. 3. Even the mini size is big enough to fit the largest plate I use - We are a family of 3 and we do not eat a lot of food or eat often. So when cups or small dishes come out, it is good to wash them and put them away right away. The largest plate is a white flat IKEA plate, and it fits if you tilt it to the side. I think it might be a little difficult to use for people who use a lot of large plates. It is a good size to put in rice bowls, soup bowls, cups, spoons, and side plates. It is a dishwasher that fits my lifestyle. If it is too big, it will not be done this quickly, and if you have to run a lot at once, it will be burdensome and the dishes will pile up. *** As I continued to use it, I realized that there are more minor disadvantages than I thought. 1. The process of adding water that requires a lot of concentration! - Many reviews said that an error occurred, but I didn't know that I would be the one who would experience that error. The E4 error occurred! This is really important. They say that you should plug in the dishwasher cord and turn on the power button! Then, add water to avoid this error. I knew this in advance from the product review, so I thought I could use it with confidence. After my husband installed it, he just poured water without thinking and didn't turn on the power button. Then, when he turned on the power button, the E4 error occurred. I looked for a blog review, and it said to drain all the water, clean it thoroughly, and then use it again. So I drained all the water, dried it, and dried it thoroughly. I barely managed to use it after getting an error and drying it several times. Please read my review and keep in mind! You should always turn on the power before adding water. And if you hear a beep while adding water, immediately stop the water supply. This is really a sustress. 2. Drying and blowing function. This is the most disappointing feature, though. When the dishwasher is done washing, it seems to dry the dishes like a fine (?) wind. If you don't open the door, it will continue to blow and dry the dishes. The blowing function is so weak that I've never seen the dishes completely dry by the next day. So it dries better if you just leave the door open. The problem is that when you leave the door open, it gets in the way of going in and out because of the door. So I bought a safety device from Daiso to prevent the door from opening and closing, and I can keep it slightly open. The door is either completely closed or completely open, which is a polar opposite. There are some disappointing points, but I'm satisfied with the price. I always have to consider the price of home appliances, so I don't want to be a greedy person anymore. If you think drying is important, you should look for other products with added functions. My husband, who said he wouldn't use it because it was a bit annoying to fill the water, is more diligent than anyone else in filling the water and running the dishwasher. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

물은 꼭 전원을 키고 나서 넣어야합니다. 그리고 물을 넣다가 삐- 소리가 나면 바로 물 공급을 중단하세요. ㅠㅠ 이게 응근히 수트레스네요 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ  2. 건조,송풍기능..이 있다지만 ㅠㅠ 그다지 ㅠㅠ 요게 제일 아쉬운 기능인데. 식기세척기가 세척을 다 마치면 미세한(?) 바람같이 그릇을 말려주는듯합니다. 문을 열지않으면 계속 송풍,건조되면서 그릇을 말려준다는데. 그 송풍기능이 너무나도 미약한 ㅋㅋㅋㅋㅋ 정도라 다음날까지도 끝까지 그릇이 뽀송하게 다 마른건 본적이 없어여 그래서 그냥 문을 열어두는게 오히려 더 잘 마를정도인데, 문제는 문을 열어두면 좀 문때매 오가기에 걸리적거립니다. 그래서 다이소에서 문열림,닫힘 방지하는 안전장치 사서 살짝만 열어두게 해놓습니다. 문 개폐도 다 닫거나 완전 열리거나 , 둘중하나라 극과극..  아쉬운점은 있으나 가격대비 만족스럽습니다. 언제나 가전제품은 가격을 생각해야하니까 더이상의 욕심쟁이는 되고싶지 않습니다. 만약 건조까지 중요하신 분들이라면 기능추가되는 다른 제품을 찾아보셔야합니다. 물 넣기가 좀 귀찮아서 않쓰게 될거라던 남편은 누구보다 열심히 물채우고 식기세척기를 열심히 돌리고 계십니다. 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Highly recommended This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Worst design ever ] || ---------------- || We purchased this dishwasher 20 months ago. We have had several Kitchenaid dishwashers and have always found the brand to be quality. When we saw this third rack dishwasher, we thought it would be an excellent upgrade. We thought wrong.Since we first installed this dishwasher, The third (top) rack has never closed without getting hung up on the spraying arm. The spraying arm always blocks it from closing. Then you have to close the middle rack, reach your arm inside to turn the spray arm sideways, all the while pushing the middle rack off its track because the spray arm is nearly impossible to get to. Then after you fix the middle rack that was pushed off its track from fixing the top rack, you might be ready to go.We tried getting help from kitchenaid, but we were always referred to the online help which mentioned nothing about the top rack not closing. No help was forthcoming from kitchenaid and we were stuck with this piece of junk.Eventually this defect caused the top spray arm to break off due to the rack constantly hitting it, thus rendering the dishwasher useless. It is now a $1000 boat anchor. I will never buy a kitchenaid dishwasher again.

Sentence (English): We bought this as a second dishwasher and I did a lot of research before we made our purchase.
Comments (English): [ Cleans well but has a few quirks ] || ---------------- || We bought this as a second dishwasher and I did a lot of research before we made our purchase. I was excited about the small top rack for little random things that usually clutter up the main trays. I also was eager to try the crystal dry technology. Both of those things are very good! the things I'm not terribly excited about are the silverware trays, which are smaller and somehow less supportive of the silverware so that they seem to want to tip out. Also, the lowest rack has a myriad of prongs going in a variety of directions that doesn't seem to fit anything very well. we are slowly growing accustomed to it and learning how to fit our dishes in, but it does not seem to hold as much as our previous KitchenAid, which we moved to another location in the house. Also, the runtime is quite long, so once you start it , you won't be able to access clean dishes for more than two hours at least at the setting we use. Another thing that I miss from our KitchenAid is the display which told us that we could either add a dish or it would indicate at what point in the wash process it was. The only indication on this dishwasher is a red light that shines on the floor to let you know that it is running a cycle. overall, it cleans very well, and I am happy with its performance, but I am disappointed that I don't like it as well as I thought I would.

Comments (English): [ Took a Chance and very happy so far ] || ---------------- || Bought this about a month ago, despite the lack of reviews. I assumed it was probably similar to other LGs but just a new model with low purchase and review history. This was an upgrade from an Electrolux and boy is it an upgrade. Fit and finish is great. Everything else has been awesome. Otherwise, that short cycle is impressive. Drying is better than our last and very good I would say. We do still see some puddles but only on the items that have the perfect design to leave a pool of water. The space ergonomics are very good too. Room for customization and the top rack is just big enough for lager utensils, tops and random items, but not too big to interfere with the second rack. Overall solid appliance and I wouldn't hesitate to give it a try if it seems to fit your needs.

Costco delivery couldn't get my old DW out due to the flooring trapping it in (another story). I had to cut the old DW to pieces with a saws-all to get it out and then finish the installation myself. Was really easy. This Dishwasher ended up being the perfect hight after I leveled the floor. So if you need to fit into a slightly smaller space (33.5'), this just fits. Everything else has been awesome. Cleans great! totally spotless on the long cycles and pretty much spotless on the 1 hr cycle, unless you overload it with too many dishes and gunk for the short cycle. Otherwise, that short cycle is impressive. Drying is better than our last and very good I would say. We do still see some puddles but only on the items that have the perfect design to leave a pool of water. The space ergonomics are very good too. Room for customization and the top rack is just big enough for lager utensils, tops and random items, but not too big to interfere with the second rack. Overall solid appliance and I wouldn't hesitate to give it a try if it seems to fit your needs.
